=== blink an LED, with the watchdog held
# Register addresses from the MSP430G2 family.
        .equ    WDTCTL, 0x0120
        .equ    WDTPW, 0x5a00
        .equ    WDTHOLD, 0x0080
        .equ    P1DIR, 0x0022
        .equ    P1OUT, 0x0021
        .equ    BIT0, 1

        .text
        .globl  main
main:   mov.w   #WDTPW|WDTHOLD, &WDTCTL   ; stop the watchdog
        mov     #0x0280, sp
        bis.b   #BIT0, &P1DIR
loop:   xor.b   #BIT0, &P1OUT
        mov     #50000, r15
1:      dec     r15
        jnz     1b
        jmp     loop

        .section __reset_vector, "ax", @progbits
        .word   main

=== a delay routine with a register frame
        .text
delay:  push    r10
        push    r11
        mov     r15, r10
outer:  mov     #1000, r11
inner:  dec     r11
        jnz     inner
        dec     r10
        jnz     outer
        pop     r11
        pop     r10
        ret

=== string output through a pointer
        .equ    UCA0TXBUF, 0x0067
        .equ    IFG2, 0x0003
        .equ    UCA0TXIFG, 2
        .text
puts:   mov.b   @r15+, r14
        tst.b   r14
        jz      2f
1:      bit.b   #UCA0TXIFG, &IFG2
        jz      1b
        mov.b   r14, &UCA0TXBUF
        jmp     puts
2:      ret
        .section .rodata
msg:    .asciz  "Hello, MSP430\r\n"

=== arithmetic on 32-bit values held in pairs of registers
        .text
add32:  add     r12, r14
        adc     r15
        add     r13, r15
        ret
sub32:  sub     r12, r14
        sbc     r15
        sub     r13, r15
        ret
neg32:  inv     r14
        inv     r15
        inc     r14
        adc     r15
        ret
shl32:  rla     r14
        rlc     r15
        ret
shr32:  clrc
        rrc     r15
        rrc     r14
        ret
bcd:    clrc
        dadd    r14, r15
        dadc    r15
        ret

=== a jump table through local label differences
        .text
dispatch:
        cmp     #3, r15
        jhs     out
        rla     r15
        add     r15, pc
        jmp     case0
        jmp     case1
        jmp     case2
case0:  mov     #10, r15
        ret
case1:  mov     #20, r15
        ret
case2:  mov     #30, r15
out:    ret
        .word   2f - 1f
1:      nop
        nop
2:      nop

=== macros and repetition
        .macro  save reg
        push    \reg
        .endm
        .macro  restore reg
        pop     \reg
        .endm
        .text
isr:    save    r15
        save    r14
        .rept   3
        rra     r14
        .endr
        .irp    r, r12, r13
        clr     \r
        .endr
        restore r14
        restore r15
        reti

=== conditional assembly
        .equ    DEBUG, 1
        .text
        .if     DEBUG
        mov     #0xdead, r15
        .else
        mov     #0, r15
        .endif
        .ifdef  UNDEFINED
        nop
        .endif
        ret

=== separators, comments and number spellings
        .text
        mov #0FFh, r15 { mov #10h, r14 ; two statements
# a line comment
        mov     #0x10, r13      ; a comment
        mov     #010, r12       ; ten, not eight
        mov     #0b1010, r11
        mov     #'A', r10
        mov     #(3 << 4) | 5, r9
        mov     #-1 & 0xff, r8
        ret

=== every addressing mode of mov, with numbers
        .text
        mov     r4, r5
        mov     4(r4), r5
        mov     &0x0200, r5
        mov     @r4, r5
        mov     @r4+, r5
        mov     #0x1234, r5
        mov     r4, 4(r5)
        mov     r4, &0x0202
        mov     4(r4), 6(r5)
        mov     &0x0200, &0x0202
        mov     @r4+, 2(r5)
        mov     #0x5678, &0x0204
        mov.b   @r4, 0(r5)
        ret

=== the constant generators in every position
        .text
        mov     #0, r5
        mov     #1, r5
        mov     #2, r5
        mov     #4, r5
        mov     #8, r5
        mov     #-1, r5
        mov     #0xffff, r5
        add     #2, 4(r5)
        cmp.b   #8, &0x0200
        bic     #4, sr
        bis     #8, sr
        push    #4
        push    #8
        push    #2
        ret

=== status bits
        .text
        dint
        nop
        setc
        setz
        setn
        clrc
        clrz
        clrn
        eint
        nop
        ret

=== alignment within code
        .text
        nop
        .balign 4
        mov     #1, r5
        .p2align 3
        mov     #2, r5
        .align  2
        ret
        .byte   1
        .balign 2
        ret

=== data in a code section
        .text
        jmp     over
        .byte   1, 2, 3
        .balign 2
        .word   0x1234, -1
        .long   0x12345678
        .ascii  "ab"
        .space  4, 0xff
over:   ret

=== jumps to numbers
        .text
        jmp     $+4
        nop
        jz      $-2
        jnz     2
        jc      -2
        ret
